chrysaorian.p: Breaks away: Chrysaorian League from Whoever holds Kaunos, Antiocheia-Alabanda and Stratonikeia (at the start, the Ptolemaic Empire and the Seleucid Empire)

cilician.p: Breaks away: Cilician Pirates from Whoever holds Nagidos and Korakesion (at the start, the Ptolemaic Empire)

egyptian.p: Breaks away: Egyptians from the Ptolemaic Empire

italics.p: Breaks away: Italics from Rome, or whoever holds the eight towns at the time

lycian_league.p: Breaks away: Lycian League from The Ptolemaic Empire, or whoever holds the Lycian cities at the time

miletus.p: Breaks away: Miletus from The Ptolemaic Empire, or whoever holds Miletos at the time

ptolemaic.p: Breaks away: Ptolemaic Rebels from The Ptolemaic Empire

rome_two_civil_wars.p: Breaks away: Roman Rebels (first civil war), Rome, Roman Rebels (second civil war) and The Roman Senate from Rome in the first war; in the second, whichever side won the first

seleucid.p: Breaks away: Seleucid Rebels (Asia Minor) and Seleucid Rebels (Upper Satrapies) from the Seleucid Empire

thessaly.p: Breaks away: Thessalian League from The Antigonid Kingdom
